events.title: The Golden King in Exile
events.fired_by: zin_aenor_exile_king (SL-25: the original Aenor annexed or capitulating while the Golden King lives)
events.desc: Aenor has fallen to its enemies, but the Golden King was not taken with his crown. He left Parim by the lake road with his household and as much of the treasury as the wagons would carry, and he keeps his court now as the guest of whoever will feed it.
